entities.name: KIF18A (query-like)
observations: 768-aa query is strongly homologous to reviewed human KIF18A (UniProt Q8NI77): 71.6% identity, 100% query coverage, E-value 0.
KIF18A annotation describes a microtubule-depolymerizing kinesin involved in chromosome congression; it reduces preanaphase chromosome oscillations and slows poleward movement during anaphase.

Homolog annotations place KIF18A in cytoplasm/cytosol, microtubule cytoskeleton, centrosome, kinetochore and mitotic spindle compartments; exact localization of query is not experimentally established here.
Pfam scans detect Microtub_bd at residues 12–171 and Kinesin domain at residues 17–355.

entities.name: Chromosome congression
observations: Human KIF18A reference annotation links the protein to chromosome congression and suppression of chromosome movements by reducing preanaphase oscillations.
KIF18A homolog annotation suggests a possible role in maintaining CENPE levels and the CENPE-BUB1B complex at kinetochores; this is not directly established for the query.

entities.name: Mitotic spindle/kinetochore
observations: Reviewed human KIF18A homolog is annotated at kinetochores, kinetochore microtubules, microtubule cytoskeleton, centrosome, and mitotic spindle structures; these are homolog-supported locations for the query.
The sequence evidence does not experimentally establish subcellular localization of the query protein.
